description: ChatData Sync turns ChatGPT into your personal tracking assistant. Describe what you want to track in plain English, and it creates a private structured tracker you can fill, search, and update directly in chat. One connection can manage multiple trackers for workflows like client invoices, garden logs, workouts, and maintenance records.
